battle.name: 拉希爾之戰
battle.brief: 644年，阿拉伯部族蓋斯派與也門派在約旦河谷拉希爾原野互擊，是第一次伊斯蘭內戰前夕兩大部族陣營公開對抗的早期爆發。卡面的斯巴達長矛屬希臘重裝步兵方陣的直刺兵器，並未出現在本役：交戰雙方用部族自備的直身矛、標槍、複合反曲弓、圓盾與彎刀，戰法是旗下各部族分列自守的野戰，而非方陣。

kit.name: 斯巴達長矛
kit.history: 兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套。方陣裡它比劍更早決定誰站得住。

countries: 這場衝突的交戰方不是國家，而是阿拉伯半島的兩大部族聯軍。蓋斯派（又稱北方部族）以泰、塔米姆等部落為主，多分布於敘利亞邊境與伊拉克城鎮的駐軍中；也門派（南方部族）以阿茲迪、馬赫安、金納迪、哈姆丹等部落為骨幹，在哈里發國的敘利亞軍區人數最多，控制著當地的騎兵與邊防稅收。644年時的哈里發國仍由哈里發奧斯曼在麥地那主持，敘利亞行省由總督穆阿維葉掌控，伊拉克與埃及各有總督與駐軍，部族之間的競爭因此不是抽象的，而是具體到駐軍番役、徵稅配給與封地分配。戰場所在的約旦河谷上游、加利利湖東岸，按當時實際控制劃分，已在阿拉伯軍自636年耶門之役後接管的區域之內，與拜占庭帝國接壤；河谷西岸與沿海城鎮仍在拜占庭手中，加沙利斯的希臘裔與拜占庭邊軍則是另一方的旁觀者與潛在盟友。阿拉伯與拜占庭的邊境戰在整個640年代不斷進行，此役正落在雙方拉鋸的高峰，部族內鬥與對外戰事在同一條前線上重疊。
countriesEn: The opposing sides in this clash were not states but two tribal coalitions of the Arabian peninsula. The Qays, the so-called northern tribes, were made up above all of the Tay and the Tamim, and were to be found largely in the garrisons of the Syrian frontier and in the towns of Iraq; the Yemeni, the southern tribes, had the Azdi, the Mahan, the Kinadi and the Hamdan as their backbone, and were the most numerous in the Syrian military district of the caliphate, where they held the cavalry and the frontier tax revenues. In 644 the caliphate was still governed from Medina by the caliph Uthman, with Mu'awiya holding Syria as governor, and Iraq and Egypt each with their own governor and garrisons, so that the competition between the tribes was not abstract but concrete, a matter of garrison duty, of rations and of the distribution of land grants. The battlefield, in the upper Jordan valley east of the Sea of Galilee, lay inside territory already taken by the Arab armies after the battle of Yarmouk in 636 and bordering the Byzantine Empire; the western bank of the river and the coastal towns were still Byzantine, and the Ghassanids of Palaestina were onlookers and potential allies. Arab-Byzantine fighting along this frontier ran through the whole of the 640s, and this battle fell at the height of it, with the tribal war and the war against Byzantium laid over one another on the same front.
people: 直接指揮這場交鋒的是兩派部眾自己的首領，其姓名在傳世阿拉伯史籍中多已失落，可確定的是他們的分量。敘利亞總督穆阿維葉·本·阿比·蘇菲亞是也門派最重要的靠山：他自640年起任敘利亞總督，麾下阿拉伯軍團以也門諸部為主力，阿茲迪、馬赫安等部落的騎兵是他手中最可靠的力量，拉希爾之戰的走向，實際上決定了敘利亞軍區此後十餘年由哪一派把持。哈里發奧斯曼·本·阿夫凡是雙方共同的裁決者，他在麥地那的分封、配給與任官，把大量原本屬於敘利亞邊緣的部族首領拉進新王朝的資源分配，也因此使部族之間的落差變成可以爭奪的東西。蓋斯派在敘利亞與伊拉克邊境的支持者中，後來在第一次伊斯蘭內戰中站在阿里·本·阿比·塔利卜一邊的扎拜爾·本·阿瓦姆、塔勒哈·本·祖拜爾都屬泰族；祖拜爾的祖父祖拜爾·本·艾比·瓦姆以戰歿希志志的武名被記為蓋斯部族的象徵。也門派在敘利亞的支柱則是穆阿維葉的同族與姻親網絡，以及長期服務於敘利亞軍區的也門部落首領。還有兩位北方將領是這十年敘利亞戰線的柱石：哈立德·本·瓦利德以速攻與強行穿越聞名，634年後在敘利亞連破拜占庭重鎮；艾布·烏拜德·本·賈拉哈自634年起任敘利亞全軍主將，直至648年病逝，軍權在他手中平穩交接。拉希爾之戰的指揮者只是這些大人物手下的部族領袖，卻在旗號與帳目上預演了十二年後的分裂。
peopleEn: Those who actually commanded the clash were the chiefs of the two tribal groupings themselves, and their names have largely been lost in the transmitted Arabic histories; what can be certain is their weight. Mu'awiya ibn Abi Sufyan, governor of Syria, was the most important patron of the Yemeni faction: from 640 he held Syria as governor, the Arab army corps under him drawing its strength from the Yemeni tribes, and the cavalry of the Azdi and the Mahan was the most reliable force in his hands, so that the course of the battle of al-Rahil in effect settled which of the two groups would hold the Syrian military district for the following dozen years. The caliph Uthman ibn Affan was the common arbiter of both sides; the grants of land, the allocations and the appointments he made from Medina drew a great many tribal chiefs from the Syrian margins into the distribution of the resources of the new dynasty, and so turned the gaps between the tribes into things that could be competed for. Among the supporters of the Qays on the Syrian and Iraqi frontier were Zubayr ibn al-Awam and Talha ibn Ubayd Allah, both of the Tay, who would later stand on the side of Ali ibn Abi Talib in the first civil war; Zubayr's grandfather Zubayr ibn Abi Warq, who fell at Hija, was remembered as a symbol of the martial honour of the Qays. The pillars of the Yemeni in Syria were Mu'awiya's own kin and marriage connections, together with the Yemeni tribal chiefs who had long served in the Syrian army. Two northern commanders were the columns of the Syrian front through these ten years: Khalid ibn al-Walid, famed for speed and for forced marches, who after 634 took Byzantine strongholds in Syria one after another; and Abu Ubayda ibn al-Jarrah, commander-in-chief of the Syrian army from 634 until his death in 648, through whose hands the command passed in orderly fashion. The commanders at al-Rahil were merely tribal chiefs under such men, yet in their banners and their accounts they rehearsed the split of twelve years later.
kits: 卡面這件斯巴達長矛是古典希臘的直刺兵器：木杆約兩米，槍尾帶銅套，以便插地、防止折斷並便於配重，矛頭細長，用於方陣中推開敵盾之後刺入身體。它屬於公元前五至四世紀的希臘重裝步兵世界，與644年相距一千二百餘年，在約旦河谷不可能出現；本役真正見於戰場的，是阿拉伯部族自備的裝備。武器方面，部族戰士用直身木矛刺擊，矛頭為鐵或青銅，杆身有箍；近身纏鬥靠單刃直刀與雙刃劍，彎刀在七世紀的阿拉伯軍中已普遍使用；遠程是複合反曲弓與骨製或木製箭鏃，弓手在部族軍中數量最多，發矢密度高而精度普通。防護是圓形小盾配皮甲或鎖子甲，多數出自薩珊與拜占庭邊軍體系的舊裝備，經戰利品與市集流入，鎧甲在部族軍中極不普及，重裝只限少數貴族。戰馬是也門派最重要的資產，蓋斯派則以步兵與長矛見長。運輸靠單峰駱駝，各部自備帳幕、食糧與椰棗，行軍自希志志或敘利亞各城前往戰場；旗幟是唯一的集結符號，每一部族推一面旗下。這套裝備的技術譜系幾乎全部來自拜占庭與薩珊的邊防軍械，而不是希臘。
kitsEn: The dory on the card is a straight thrusting weapon of classical Greece: a wooden shaft about two metres long with a bronze socket at the butt, so that it could be planted in the ground, prevented from snapping and was easy to weight, and a narrow head, used in the phalanx to push an enemy shield aside and then stab the body behind it. It belongs to the world of the Greek heavy infantry of the fifth to fourth centuries BC, more than twelve hundred years away from 644, and could not have appeared in the Jordan valley; what was actually on the battlefield in this engagement was the equipment the Arab tribes carried themselves. As for weapons, the tribal warriors thrust with straight wooden spears whose heads were of iron or bronze and whose shafts were bound with rings; close fighting was done with single-edged straight knives and two-edged swords, and the curved sabre was already in common use in the Arab armies of the seventh century; at range they used the composite recurve bow with bone or wooden arrowheads, and archers were the most numerous component of a tribal army, high in rate of fire and modest in accuracy. Defence was a small round shield with a coat of leather or mail, mostly the old equipment of the Sasanian and Byzantine frontier systems carried in as booty and bought in the markets, while armour was extremely scarce in tribal armies and full equipment was the mark of a few chiefs. Horses were the Yemeni's most important asset, while the Qays relied on infantry and spears. Transport was by dromedary, each tribe carrying its own tents, provisions and dates, and marching from Hija or from the Syrian towns to the field; the banner was the only symbol for rallying, one banner to each tribe. The technical pedigree of this equipment came almost entirely from the Byzantine and Sasanian frontier armies, and not from Greece.
tactics: 拉希爾之戰是一場典型的部族野戰，沒有圍城、沒有攻城器械，也沒有任何可以調動的技術：雙方在約旦河谷的開闊地與起伏丘陵上遭遇，勝負由三件事決定。第一是旗幟：每一部族在自己的旗下自成一團，旗手與首領的存亡就是該部的存亡，一旦某部崩散，其餘各部失去牽引便各自為戰。第二是地形：河谷北段狹窄，縱隊與騎兵難以展開，縱有騎兵優勢的一方也只能力戰；南段接近湖汊與沼澤，後方取水與草料不便，強行追擊容易失去縱隊秩序。第三是水源與季節：644年年中一帶酷熱乾燥，交戰雙方都倚賴約旦河與支流的取水點，誰控制河道與渡口，誰就能維持一日以上的接戰。部族聯軍的典型打法是：步兵列成疏鬆的橫陣，長矛手在前、弓手在後，騎兵在兩翼反覆衝擊騷擾，待敵陣出現缺口才由首領率本族輪番投入；沒有統一號令，也沒有預定的總攻時刻。阿拉伯部族另有把人質互換、互保互不侵犯的習俗，傳統記載認為此役正是某次破壞人質約定或水草地界爭執引發，故在部族記憶中被記為背信之一役。卡面的斯巴達長矛所代表的方陣直刺邏輯——以整齊矛牆同時推進、再在盾線後刺出——在本役完全不存在。
tacticsEn: The battle of al-Rahil was a tribal field action of the ordinary kind: there was no siege, no siege engine and no technical means that could be brought to bear, and the two sides met in the open country and broken hills of the Jordan valley, with the outcome decided by three things. The first was the banner: each tribe formed a body of its own under its own flag, the survival of the standard-bearer and the chief was the survival of the tribe, and once one contingent broke up the rest lost their rallying point and fought each for itself. The second was the ground: the northern stretch of the valley is narrow, so that a column and its cavalry could not deploy, and even a side with the advantage in horse could only fight in place; the southern stretch approaches the lake and the marshes, where water and fodder for the rear were hard to come by and a hard pursuit easily threw the order of a column away. The third was water and season: the country in the middle of 644 was hot and dry, and both sides drew on the Jordan and its tributaries for water, so that whoever held the river and the fords could keep a battle going for more than a day. The usual method of a tribal confederate was this: infantry drawn up in a loose line with spear-men in front and archers behind, cavalry harassing and striking at the wings in repeated charges, and only when a gap opened in the enemy line did a chief commit his own tribe in turn; there was no unified signal and no appointed moment for the general assault. Arab tribal custom also held that hostages were exchanged to guarantee mutual safety, and the traditional account holds that this engagement was set off by the breaking of such a pledge or by a dispute over water and pasture, so that in tribal memory it was remembered as one of the wars of broken faith. The logic of the phalanx thrust that the dory on the card stands for, an even wall of spears advancing together and stabbing out from behind a shield line, was entirely absent here.
data: 可確定的數字有限，只能列出有根據者。時間：644年，約當伊歷二十三、二十四年之交；戰役的確切日期與月份沒有留下記載，傳統把拉希爾之戰繫於該年年中，卡面取七月。地點：拉希爾一般被置於約旦河上游、加利利湖東岸，靠近約旦河與亞穆克河匯流的地帶，說法之間有出入，因此本卡取東經35.55度、北緯32.72度為代表點；由此到敘利亞總督駐地賈比耶約一百五十至二百公里，到麥地那沿希志志道超過一千公里。規模：阿拉伯史家沒有留下拉希爾之戰的雙方兵力數字；按當時部族徵召的常規與敘利亞前線的部署，雙方可視為各數百至數千人，遠小於同一時期的大會戰。對照數字可用：656年駱駝之戰的傳統記載合計約一萬四千人，兩軍各約七千；636年耶門之戰的阿拉伯軍投入亦在數萬量級，而拉希爾之戰在部族史的敘述中被歸入小戰一類。時間跨度：拉希爾之戰的爆發到第一次伊斯蘭內戰全面化，即656年駱駝之戰之間，約十二年。戰損與俘虜數目無可靠記載；可以確認的只有傷亡集中在旗手與首領一級，以及蓋斯派若干部眾在此役之後長期退居二線的結果。河谷可展開陣地的長度約數十公里，配合河道與渡口的距離，較能還原當時的會戰條件。載具方面，阿拉伯軍隊在640年代已經使用單峰駱駝作戰役運輸，這是本役後勤的基本前提。
dataEn: The numbers that can be established with certainty are few, and only those with a basis can be listed. Time: 644 CE, roughly the turn of AH 23 and AH 24; no record gives the exact date or month of the battle, tradition placing the battle of al-Rahil in the middle of that year, and the card takes July. Place: al-Rahil is generally put in the upper Jordan valley, east of the Sea of Galilee, near where the Jordan and the Yarmouk meet; the accounts differ, so the card takes longitude 35.55 and latitude 32.72 as the representative point. From there it is about one hundred and fifty to two hundred kilometres to the governor's seat at Jabiya, and more than a thousand kilometres to Medina by the road of Hija. Scale: the Arabic historians have left no reliable figures for the strength of either side at al-Rahil; judged by the ordinary practice of tribal levy and by the deployment on the Syrian front, each side may be reckoned at some hundreds to a few thousand men, far smaller than the great pitched battles of the same period. Figures for comparison are available: the traditional account of the Battle of the Camel in 656 gives a total of some fourteen thousand, about seven thousand on either side, and the Arab commitment at Yarmouk in 636 was likewise in the tens of thousands, while the battle of al-Rahil is classed among the small actions in the narrative of the tribes. Interval: about twelve years separate the outbreak of al-Rahil from the full opening of the first civil war, the Battle of the Camel of 656. There is no reliable record of losses or prisoners; what can be confirmed is that the casualties fell on standard-bearers and chiefs in the first instance, and that certain Qaysi groups fell back out of the first rank for a long time after this battle. The length of ground in the valley in which a line could be deployed was some tens of kilometres, and the distances of river and fords go some way toward reconstructing the conditions of the encounter. As for transport, the Arab armies were already using the dromedary for campaign supply in the 640s, and that was the basic premise of this engagement's logistics.
cause: 拉希爾之戰的直接起因，在阿拉伯史料中只剩下片斷記載，學界通常把它放在兩層背景裡理解。表層是敘利亞前線的一次具體衝突：蓋斯與也門兩派部眾同駐敘利亞與伊拉克的邊防城鎮，共享水源、牧場、徵召名額與哈里發政府的配給，部族之間長期的積怨，終於在一場關於人質歸還、渡口使用或草場界線的爭執中爆開；阿拉伯部族的傳統把破壞人質誓約視為不可饒恕的罪，因此交鋒一旦開始便不留餘地。深層的原因，是新生的哈里發國把大量部族首領帶進了資源分配的決策圈：奧斯曼在麥地那進行分封與授職，把敘利亞與伊拉克的稅收、土地和戰功分派下去，於是「哪一族的人先得位」的問題變得可以量化，部族榮譽第一次有了明確的物質內容。哈里發國本身沒有常備中央軍，軍隊是按部族臨時徵召的聯軍，效忠的對象是部族首領而不是中央，這使政治競爭天然會以部族武力解決的方式表現。外部壓力則加速了這一切：拜占庭帝國仍在河西與沿海固守，其邊軍與加沙利斯的希臘裔不斷干擾阿拉伯前線，阿拉伯軍在沒有中央常備力量的情況下必須靠部族忠誠度戰，而每一場前線勝利都會加劇內部的分配矛盾。
causeEn: The immediate occasion of the battle of al-Rahil survives in the Arabic sources only in scattered notices, and scholarship usually reads it against two layers of background. The surface layer is a particular collision on the Syrian front: Qaysi and Yemeni people were quartered together in the frontier towns of Syria and Iraq, sharing water, pasture, places in the levy and the rations of the caliphal government, and the long accumulation of tribal grudges finally broke open in a dispute over the return of hostages, the use of a ford or the line of a grazing ground; Arab tribal custom held the breaking of a pledge of hostages to be an unforgivable wrong, and so once the fighting began no quarter was given. The deeper cause lies in the fact that the newborn caliphate had drawn a great many tribal chiefs into the circle where resources were distributed: by his grants and appointments from Medina, Uthman assigned the taxes, the land and the credit of Syria and Iraq, and the question of which tribe got its share first became measurable, so that tribal honour received for the first time an explicit material content. The caliphate itself had no standing central army; its forces were confederates levied by tribe, and the loyalty they owed was owed to their own chiefs rather than to the centre, so that political competition naturally took the form of tribal armed strength. Outside pressure accelerated all of this: the Byzantine Empire still held the west bank and the coast, its frontier troops and the Ghassanids of Palaestina continually disturbed the Arab front, and with no standing central force the Arab armies had to fight on the loyalty of tribes, while every victory on the front added to the quarrel over distribution at home.
impact: 拉希爾之戰的直接後果，是也門派在敘利亞軍區的地位穩固下來。從644年到661年穆阿維葉即位為哈里發，敘利亞的阿拉伯軍團、稅收與邊防實際上都由也門部族把持；穆阿維葉能夠在第一次伊斯蘭內戰中與阿里對峙、能在657年迫使對方接受調解、能在661年接替哈里發之位，其政權基礎正是這些年由部族將領與騎兵支撐的敘利亞軍力，而拉希爾之戰是這支力量第一次在記錄中擊敗蓋斯派、確立自己的地方。另一面的後果落在蓋斯派身上：部族挫折加深了他們對也門派壟斷敘利亞軍職的不滿，這份不滿在十二年後的656年駱駝之戰中爆發，祖拜爾、塔勒哈等蓋斯族領袖加入艾伊莎的聯軍，與也門派再度對撞，並在戰敗中付出性命代價；到680年卡巴拉，蓋斯派支持侯賽因的姿態仍然清晰。制度層面的影響更長：這場戰爭顯示，純粹按部族編組的軍隊效忠領袖多於效忠哈里發，後來伍麥葉王朝不得不發展出非部族的常備軍與以中央薪餉維持的兵員，逐步壓縮部族聯軍的比重。也門派與蓋斯派的分野成為解讀整個早期伊斯蘭政治的核心變數，也成為後世伊斯蘭史家論述阿薩比耶（部族團結）時最常用的樣本。
impactEn: The direct consequence of the battle of al-Rahil was the consolidation of the Yemeni in the Syrian military district. From 644 until Mu'awiya's accession as caliph in 661, the Arab army corps, the taxes and the frontier of Syria were in practice in the hands of the Yemeni tribes; Mu'awiya's ability to stand against Ali in the first civil war, to force the acceptance of the arbitration in 657, and to take the caliphate in 661, rested on a Syrian military power sustained through those years by tribal commanders and cavalry, and al-Rahil was the first recorded occasion on which that force beat the Qaysi and established its own place. The other consequence fell on the Qaysi: the tribal defeat deepened their resentment at the Yemeni monopoly of commands in Syria, and that resentment broke out at the Battle of the Camel in 656, twelve years later, when chiefs of the Qays such as Zubayr and Talha joined Aisha's confederate army, collided once more with the Yemeni, and paid for the defeat with their lives; the same Qaysi posture in favour of Husayn is still plainly visible at Karbala in 680. The institutional effect is of longer reach: this battle showed that an army organised purely by tribe owed more to its chiefs than to the caliph, and the Umayyad dynasty was later driven to develop non-tribal standing troops and men maintained on the central payroll, progressively reducing the share of tribal confederates. The division between the Yemeni and the Qaysi became the central variable for reading the politics of early Islam and the standing example used by later Islamic historians when discussing asabiyya, the solidarity of the tribe.
result: 結果是也門派勝出，蓋斯派受挫。拉希爾原野上，蓋斯派各部眾在旗幟散亂、首領陣亡或被俘之後失去戰鬥意志，退出戰鬥；也門派則以騎兵與步卒的輪替消耗了對手的銳氣，並留在原地控制住水源與道路。戰役本身沒有改變哈里發國的疆域，也沒有換掉任何一位哈里發：奧斯曼仍在麥地那，敘利亞仍歸穆阿維葉管轄，兩派的爭執仍沒有制度化的裁決。這場勝仗的真正意義在往後：蓋斯派的挫敗使其在第一內戰中轉向支持阿里，也門派則繼續倚靠穆阿維葉的敘利亞軍；到656年駱駝之戰、657年的調解與661年阿里遇刺身亡，哈里發國的權力最終落到以敘利亞為基地的伍麥葉王朝手中，穆阿維葉開創的王朝統治延續近九十年。就裝備與戰術史而言，拉希爾之戰留下的是阿拉伯部族聯軍的戰法樣本：各部族以旗幟為單位分列自守、沒有統一號令、沒有方陣、沒有攻城器械，卻能在一天之內以騎兵衝擊與標槍覆蓋分出勝負；這套樣本在往後的內戰中重複出現，而卡面那件從未到過約旦河谷的斯巴達長矛，正好標示出這條戰術譜系與古典方陣之間的距離。
resultEn: The outcome was a Yemeni victory and a Qaysi defeat. On the field of al-Rahil the Qaysi contingents lost the will to fight once their banners were scattered and their chiefs lay dead or captive, and they withdrew from the engagement; the Yemeni wore down the edge of their opponents by alternating cavalry with foot, and stayed on the ground holding the water and the roads. The battle itself changed no frontier of the caliphate and displaced no caliph: Uthman was still in Medina, Syria was still Mu'awiya's, and the quarrel between the two groupings had still no institutional settlement. The real meaning of the victory lies in what followed: the Qaysi defeat turned them toward supporting Ali in the first civil war, while the Yemeni continued to lean on Mu'awiya's Syrian army; by the Battle of the Camel in 656, the arbitration of 657 and the assassination of Ali in 661, the power of the caliphate had passed to the Umayyad dynasty based on Syria, and the dynastic rule founded by Mu'awiya lasted for close to ninety years. In the history of equipment and tactics, what al-Rahil leaves behind is the tactical model of the Arab tribal confederate: each tribe standing on its own under its own banner, with no unified signal, no phalanx and no siege engine, yet able to settle a battle in a single day by cavalry charge and by the covering fire of javelins. That model repeated itself in the civil wars that followed, and the dory on the card, which never reached the Jordan valley, marks precisely the distance between this tactical pedigree and the classical phalanx.
